component.name: VapourKit
component.summary: AI Video Upscaling GUI for VapourSynth

description.p: VapourKit is an advanced graphical interface for VapourSynth-powered AI video upscaling and processing. It supports ONNX Runtime (CPU/CUDA) and TensorRT backends for model inference when the corresponding VapourSynth plugins are available, with an extensible filter chain system.

ul.li: AI model upscaling with ONNX Runtime and TensorRT
Segment preview and live output monitoring

description.p: Linux builds use native VapourSynth, FFmpeg, Python, BestSource, and vs-mlrt plugins. Backend availability is detected at runtime.
